scopeRule: Keep a Shobi entry in the public perfume-dupe catalog only when the original inspiration is a genuine wearable perfume product. Exclude candles, home fragrances, room sprays, body/hair/perfume mists, body-care/amenity products, laundry scents and other non-perfume originals even when Shobi sells its own version as Eau de Parfum.
method: Rechecked the current 2324-row Shobi live catalog and previous perfume-only audit.
Reviewed high-risk brands/product families where Fragrantica can contain non-perfume entries.
Used exact product-type evidence rather than treating the presence of a Fragrantica ID as proof that the original is a true perfume.
Excluded entries when the original is confirmed non-wearable or when a genuine exact wearable original cannot be demonstrated after targeted research.
